properties.description: Carga dim_race desde silver.races con SQL Source. Verificar columnas raceId, year, round, name, date, time y nombre del dataset Silver. race_sk es IDENTITY y no se envía.

scriptLines: query: 'SELECT TRY_CONVERT(int, r.raceId) AS race_id, TRY_CONVERT(smallint, r.[year]) AS season_year, TRY_CONVERT(tinyint, r.[round]) AS round_number, LEFT(LTRIM(RTRIM(r.[name])), 120) AS race_name, TRY_CONVERT(date, r.[date]) AS race_date, TRY_CONVERT(time(0), NULLIF(CAST(r.[time] AS varchar(50)), \'\\N\')) AS race_time_utc FROM silver.races r WHERE TRY_CONVERT(int, r.raceId) IS NOT NULL AND TRY_CONVERT(smallint, r.[year]) IS NOT NULL AND TRY_CONVERT(tinyint, r.[round]) IS NOT NULL AND NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(r.[name])), \'\') IS NOT NULL AND TRY_CONVERT(date, r.[date]) IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM gold.dim_race g WHERE g.race_id = TRY_CONVERT(int, r.raceId))',
